project_type: TypeScript CLI tool (zero runtime deps, ESM)
build_system: Custom build script (scripts/build.mjs) using tsc with tsconfig.build.json
test_framework: Node.js built-in test runner (node:test) with tsx loader, tests in tests/unit/**/*.test.ts
verification_instructions: 1. npm run typecheck (must pass with zero errors), 2. npm test (all unit tests pass), 3. npm run build (compiles to dist/)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external package installs. Node.js 22+ pre-installed. Use pre-installed packages only (typescript, tsx, @types/node).
contribution_requirements: Zero runtime dependencies. All imports use .ts extensions. Types imported with 'import type'. Test files use node:test + node:assert/strict. Temp dirs via fs.mkdtemp for test isolation.
key_patterns: CLI commands dispatched via argv[0] in runCliCommand(). Each returns CliCommandResult {exitCode, data, stdout?}. Human-readable output uses renderXxxResult() from render.ts. JSON mode via --json flag. Knowledge stored at .legora/repository-knowledge.json. Freshness check returns CURRENT/STALE/UNKNOWN.
directory_structure: src/ - source code (bootstrap/, cli/, core/, doctor/, providers/, repository-knowledge/, skills/). tests/ - test code (unit/, integration/, fixtures/, helpers/). scripts/ - build tools. docs/ - design docs. skills/ - agent skill definitions.
